summary: A very quiet week -- 24 messages versus 112 the week before -- and the quiet is the story. Kirsten stayed cooperative (added a Snapchat fan within 34 minutes, uploaded all three customs to the Drive on Aug 9, took Ollie's proactive OF-login disclosure warmly), but the two things she is actually waiting on both went another week without an answer. Derrek's Aug 1 promise of 'plenty of updates starting next week' on the $40k phone-farm/IG rollout produced one uncaptioned screenshot on Aug 13, and her Aug 2 questions about the Meta higher-up rep cost split and the Monday switch are still unanswered 12 days on. Her only substantive message of the week was a chase on Aug 14 -- 'the other two still will affect my account about posting?' -- which got 'Will check' from Vivek and nothing more. Separately Ollie pitched her a dildo-sucking custom on Aug 10, something she had ruled out in writing in her Jul 14 boundary brief, costing an ~$800 sale. Wesley's anniversary sends (flowers Aug 11, custom/sexting Aug 14) both came due this week with zero confirmation in chat, and she is highly protective of him. No blow-ups, no invoice in the window -- but she has gone from 73 messages a week to 11, which reads as disengagement rather than contentment.
